scope: Wave2D Google Business Profile provider support
implementation: Account-scoped notification GET and PATCH preserve unrelated notification types, reject conflicting topics, never retry mutations, and remain account-administration operations outside the public provider barrel.
Account notification reconciliation accepts the server-computed final event set, removes GOOGLE_UPDATE without removing unrelated types, and clears the topic only with an empty final event set.
Location and attribute Google Updates use separate Zod response schemas and separate documented endpoints.
Google update masks retain exact sorted field paths, support ancestor and descendant overlap, and return fail-all classification for unknown roots.
A combined provider observation returns separately parsed location and attribute results with one injected observation timestamp.
